newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber mixed but off lows on stock news.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber mixed but off lows on stock news.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed but off early lows, supported by news that Japan's rubber stocks as of December 20 were down 2,419 tonnes from December 10, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.0 yen per kg lower to 0.8 yen up, with benchmark June ending up 0.8 yen at 148.8 yen.

"News of falls in rubber stocks stimulated short-covering ahead of the close, but otherwise activity was dominated by year-end position-adjustment trade," one trader said. The benchmark June could test 150.0 yen on Friday, he added. - Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
